line: Send marketing campaigns and automated messages, plus app email through Relay.

free.text: 90 days, 500 contacts; Relay: 30 days, 50 to 400 emails/day

subs.math: 1,000 contacts × 4 campaigns = 4,000 emails a month. The USD 18 plan, plus USD 0 for extra sends.
5,000 contacts × 4 campaigns = 20,000 emails a month. The USD 58 plan, plus USD 0 for extra sends.
10,000 contacts × 4 campaigns = 40,000 emails a month. The USD 92 plan, plus USD 0 for extra sends.
50,000 contacts × 4 campaigns = 200,000 emails a month. USD 257 covers this four-campaign workload. Higher volumes may need a different plan.

appmail.math: The 50,000-email Relay costs USD 30 a month, with no extra charge at 3,000 emails. You must request team activation.
The 50,000-email Relay costs USD 30 a month, with no extra charge at 10,000 emails. You must request team activation.
The 50,000-email Relay costs USD 30 a month, and that exactly uses the full quota. You must request team activation.
The 100,000-email Relay costs USD 58 a month, with no extra charge. You must request team activation.
